selected_experiment.question: Is the verified WHNF reuse intrinsically valuable but hidden by cache lookup overhead, or is reuse itself economically neutral at this frontier?

classification_rule.reuse_gross_beneficial: median lookup-only wall time > median scoped-cache wall time
classification_rule.guard_overhead_positive: median declaration-guard-only wall time > median cold wall time
classification_rule.lookup_overhead_positive: median lookup-only wall time > median declaration-guard-only wall time
classification_rule.net_win: median scoped-cache wall time < median cold wall time

post_result_policy.if_gross_beneficial_but_net_negative: compile lookup-overhead obstruction and select a cheaper exact key/placement realization
post_result_policy.if_not_gross_beneficial: compile a cache-at-this-frontier obstruction and pivot away from WHNF memoization
post_result_policy.if_net_win: promote scoped cache economically and reclose

claim_boundary: Diagnostic decomposition only. No new Lean semantic rule or cache is promoted by this precommit.
